title: By the Numbers
why: Fact-led listicle for cold visitors comparing swamp and party options: every number is checkable.
hook_options: Our whole pitch fits in six numbers
Skip the brochure. Here are the numbers.
caption: Seven miles from the Quarter, fifteen minutes in an Uber, an hour forty-five on Bayou Bienvenue, up to 25 of your people, one real restroom, zero drinks sold. That is the whole pitch. Save it for the group chat. #neworleans #nolapartybarge #bayoubienvenue #byob

slides.kicker: NOLA Party Barge, by the numbers
slides.headline: Six numbers. No adjectives.
Miles from the French Quarter
slides.body: We launch from 2101 Paris Road, inside Orleans Parish. No bridge, no river crossing.

slides.headline: Minutes in an Uber from the Quarter
slides.body: Most swamp tours launch 45 to 60 minutes out. You are on the water before that van clears the interstate.

slides.headline: Hours on the water, every trip
slides.body: Long enough to settle in, find the wildlife, and watch the light change over the marsh.

slides.headline: Guests max on our biggest boats
slides.body: Freaky Tiki and Twerkin' Tiki hold 25. Party Queen takes 22. Bayou Boogie, 18.

slides.headline: Real restroom on board
slides.body: Not a bucket. Not a tree. With a cooler and 105 minutes, this might be the number that matters most.

slides.headline: Drinks sold on board
slides.body: It is BYOB. Bring the cooler, the snacks, the playlist. No tab, no minimums.

slides.headline: Ways on: private, shared seats, eco tour
slides.body: Private fleet for your group. Per-seat social boat for two. A slower naturalist tour for the birds.

slides.headline: 7 miles. 15 minutes. 1:45 aboard.
slides.body: Up to 25 of your people, one real restroom, zero bar tab.

slides.kicker: Save this for the group chat
